- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 17:13
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considerations for designing a comprehensive leave management system for new joiners based on their joined or confirmation date.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Leave balance calculation: Options include starting new joiners with a full leave balance or a partial leave balance that accrues over time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Leave rollover: Suggested allowing new joiners to roll over up to 10 days of unused leave to the next year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Leave request history: Recommended including a feature for new joiners to view their leave request history, including dates, duration, status, and reasons for rejections.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Leave request approvals by proxy: Suggested allowing new joiners to delegate leave request approvals to a proxy, such as a team leader or manager.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Integration with Single Sign-On (SSO): Recommended integrating the leave management system with SSO for easier access using SSO credentials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Emphasized that the specific features and considerations will depend on the requirements and constraints of the specific use case.
